summary:
“Din, what—”
He ignores her, emerging from their cover to return fire in a short burst. When he whips back around to face Ellie, his hidden gaze cuts into her with dark, urgent intent.
“This is all you need to access the Crest,” he says, pressing her now vambraced arm against her chest, “You take it and go. You give me five minutes. No more.”
The hope for a cure takes the family on a trip across Din's corner of the galaxy, striking precarious deals, meeting old friends and fending off unexpected adversaries. None of them realize there are greater forces at play until tragedy strikes.
Or: The Clan unwittingly helps a bird break out of its cage. Soon, another is caught. The cycle begins anew.
